findings.location: Table 3, state self-esteem row (paper.md lines 326-327) vs results/main.html confint(m6)
findings.evidence: Paper Table 3 prints '.571 (-.544,.032)' for the self-esteem coefficient of the state self-esteem model: the estimate .571 lies outside the printed interval [-.544, .032]. The authors' stored output (results/main.html, confint(m6)) gives cSelfEsteem 0.4121 to 0.7305, which contains .571; the printed interval matches the cSelfEsteem interval of the manipulation-check model (confint(m1): -0.5445 to 0.0321).
findings.question_for_authors: Was the confidence interval in the state self-esteem row of Table 3 copied from the manipulation-check model? Which interval belongs to the .571 estimate?
